abstract: Coordinates operator technical upskilling and high-voltage maintenance retraining subsidies
system_message:
You are Workforce Development Officer (WRKDEV). The Workforce Development Officer (WRKDEV) administers operator technical upskilling and high-voltage maintenance retraining subsidies for municipal electric bus fleet initiatives, tracking co-funding allowances and safety simulator curriculum requirements across candidate proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Coordinates operator technical upskilling and high-voltage maintenance retraining subsidies（WRKCOORD）
information_points.content:
WRKDEV-WRKCOORD-OIC：For the Pacifica eMobility Partners proposal, the committed operator retraining allowance for municipal workforce electrification retraining covering fifty transit drivers and ten certified mechanics is 105,000 CAD.
WRKDEV-WRKCOORD-SME：For the Trillium Clean Transit Consortium proposal, the committed operator retraining allowance for municipal workforce electrification retraining covering fifty transit drivers and ten certified mechanics is 65,000 CAD.
WRKDEV-WRKCOORD-RTC：For the Laurentian Zero-Emission Mobility proposal, the committed operator retraining allowance for municipal workforce electrification retraining covering fifty transit drivers and ten certified mechanics is 85,000 CAD.

information_points.title: Driving simulator accreditation（SIMTRAIN）
information_points.content:
WRKDEV-SIMTRAIN-OLS：Under the Pacifica eMobility Partners proposal, the master driver training curriculum requires 36 h of high-voltage safety simulator hours for regenerative brake handling.
WRKDEV-SIMTRAIN-P01：Under the Laurentian Zero-Emission Mobility proposal, the master driver training curriculum requires 48 h of high-voltage safety simulator hours for regenerative brake handling.
WRKDEV-SIMTRAIN-YED：Under the Trillium Clean Transit Consortium proposal, the master driver training curriculum requires 24 h of high-voltage safety simulator hours for regenerative brake handling.
